module: Exit guard "confirmPhotomodeExit": prevents leaving photo mode without confirmation. It allows navigation if the target route is still within photo mode (route "<profile>.photomode" or its sub-routes, the profile coming from ui_photomode_shared.S.activeProfile, "pause" by default), if no photo session is active, if the persistent session is enabled, or if the confirmation bypass is armed. Otherwise it requests confirmation via ui_photomode_session.requestExitConfirmation and blocks the navigation (returns false).

guards.desc: Table of exposed guards: {confirmPhotomodeExit = function(route, params, context) -> boolean}.
